description: This is an integration test class for verifying the behavior of the IndexInitializer in MongoDB, specifically testing index creation, conflict resolution, and deletion of undefined indices.

classes.name: IndexInitializerIT
classes.description: A JUnit-based integration test class for testing MongoDB index initialization logic in various scenarios.

methods.name: startMongoResource
methods.description: Initializes the MongoDbResource before any tests run.

methods.name: stopMongoResource
methods.description: Stops the MongoDbResource after all tests have completed.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up the testing environment including ActorSystem, Materializer, Mongo client, and IndexInitializer before each test.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as ActorSystem, Materializer, and Mongo database after each test.

methods.name: initializeSucceedsWhenNoIndicesExistYet
methods.description: Test case verifying index initialization when no indices exist.

methods.name: initializeSucceedsWhenNoIndicesAreDefined
methods.description: Test case verifying index initialization when empty index list is provided.

methods.name: initializeSucceedsWhenIndexWithDifferentIndexOrderIsCreated
methods.description: Test case verifying index initialization with different index order.

methods.name: initializeSucceedsWhenIndexWithAdditionalFieldIsCreated
methods.description: Test case verifying index initialization when additional index fields are added.

methods.name: initializeIgnoresIndexCreateWhenConflictingIndexWithSameUniqueAlreadyExists
methods.description: Test case verifying that conflicting index creation with same unique constraint is ignored.

methods.name: initializeFailsWhenConflictingIndexWithSameNameAlreadyExists
methods.description: Test case verifying failure when a conflicting index with the same name exists.

methods.name: initializeSucceedsWhenNoConflictingIndicesExist
methods.description: Test case verifying behavior when there are no conflicting indices.

methods.name: initializeDeletesUndefinedIndices
methods.description: Test case that verifies that undefined indices are deleted during initialization.

methods.name: createIndices
methods.description: Helper method to create indices in a MongoDB collection.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Helper method to invoke index initialization.

methods.name: assertIndices
methods.description: Asserts that the MongoDB collection has the expected indices.

methods.name: runBlocking
methods.description: Blocks on a CompletionStage until it completes.

methods.name: mapToRuntimeException
methods.description: Converts a Throwable to a RuntimeException, rethrowing if already one.
